title: GTA 6 leaker threatens to leak the full game ⚠️
subject: gta6
description:
Do you think Take-Two will respond? 👇

The GTA 6 leak group Cyberleek said on October 10 it would release a full story mode build if its crypto coin hits a $30 million market cap, demanding physical discs and a public apology from Take-Two. The claim is unverified. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: VGC (Oct 11, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 10, 2026), GamesRadar+ (Oct 11, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: A GTA 6 leaker threatens to leak the entire game.
The group, Cyberleek, has spent nearly two months posting unauthorized gameplay clips.
scenes.search: hacker hoodie dark room computer screens

scenes.text: On October 10, it promised a full story mode build, played to the credits, if its crypto coin hits a $30 million market cap.
The group says Take-Two's only way out is physical discs and a public apology.
scenes.search: video game disc case close up

scenes.text: The build isn't verified, and Take-Two has already subpoenaed Discord over the leaks.
GTA 6 is still set to launch on November 19.
